name: Elena Rodriguez Garcia
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began in her father's machine shop in Madrid, where she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the intricacies of metalwork. Her passion for precision and problem-solving led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she joined a local racing team as a junior machinist. She quickly proved her worth, demonstrating an exceptional ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues. 

Elena joined AF Corse a decade ago, bringing her wealth of experience and unwavering dedication to the team. She's renowned for her meticulous approach to every task, whether it's fine-tuning a suspension component or crafting a custom exhaust system. Her ambition to push the boundaries of performance is matched only by her unwavering commitment to quality and reliability. Elena is driven by a desire to see her team succeed and is always looking for innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge.

Elena’s perfectionist nature borders on legendary within the team. She meticulously double-checks everything, ensuring that every component meets her exacting standards. This level of dedication, combined with her creative problem-solving skills, makes her an invaluable asset to AF Corse.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is a strong, athletic woman with a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her wrench against her leg when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning her tools meticulously at the end of each day, regardless of how late it is.
